2610.03934.title: SGAnalog: An End-to-End Circuit Benchmark from Open-Source Silicon Tapeouts
2610.03934.paper_summary: Existing analog integrated circuit design benchmarks make two questions hard to answer: whether a model has learned transferable circuit skills rather than recalled familiar examples, and whether its output works under defined process and test conditions. We introduce a benchmark built from human-designed, open-source circuits associated with Tiny Tapeout manufacturing shuttles. The collection contains 273 topologically distinct top-level designs. Every source is retrieved at the revision recorded for its shuttle submission and processed in a fixed containerized environment. The pipeline exports each eligible schematic image and its SPICE netlist from the same source file, giving transcription an exact structural reference. Commit dates support model-specific training-cutoff analysis, while author testbenches provide the simulation context for sizing. The benchmark evaluates schematic-to-netlist transcription and device sizing. Across seven models on a fixed set of 66 transcription tasks, the strongest model reaches 56.1% exact graph isomorphism, and six of seven models drop sharply from the small to the medium tier. For one frontier model, removing author-chosen labels reduces exact matches while preserving aggregate structural F1, suggesting that labels can aid connectivity tracing. On the 17 sizing tasks, the leading model converges on all 17 proposals and reaches 91.2 out of 100 against the human reference, while the two newest Claude models refuse 4 and 11 of the same prompts they transcribe without objection; a proposal without sizes scores zero. The two tasks produce different model rankings, exposing distinct visual and design capabilities and, in one family, a policy rather than capability limit.
2610.03934.paper_summary_zh: 現有的類比集成電路設計基準使得兩個問題難以回答：一個模型是否學會了可轉移的電路技能，而不是回憶起熟悉的範例，以及它的輸出是否在定義的製程和測試條件下有效。我們介紹了一個基於人類設計的開源電路的基準，這些電路與 Tiny Tapeout 製造運輸相關。該集合包含 273 個拓撲上不同的頂層設計。每個來源都在其運輸提交所記錄的修訂版本中檢索，並在固定的容器化環境中處理。該流程從同一源文件中導出每個合格的原理圖圖像及其 SPICE 網表，為轉錄提供精確的結構參考。提交日期支持模型特定的訓練截止分析，而作者測試平台提供了尺寸設定的模擬上下文。該基準評估原理圖到網表的轉錄及設備尺寸設定。在固定的 66 個轉錄任務上，七個模型中最強的模型達到 56.1% 的精確圖同構，而七個模型中有六個從小型級別急劇下降到中型級別。對於一個前沿模型，移除作者選擇的標籤會減少精確匹配，同時保持總體結構 F1，這表明標籤可以幫助連通性追蹤。在 17 個尺寸設定任務中，領先模型在所有 17 個提案上收斂，並在對人類參考的評分中達到 91.2 分（滿分 100 分），而兩個最新的 Claude 模型拒絕了 4 和 11 個相同的提示，這些提示它們在轉錄時沒有異議；一個沒有尺寸的提案得分為零。這兩個任務產生了不同的模型排名，揭示了不同的視覺和設計能力，在一個家族中，這是一種政策而非能力的限制。
